revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - Accept. See Sosin's comments. The initial beta is a bit smaller than expected, and its top is somewhat obscured by the rho from the previous line, but this looks to me like a nice reading, supported by the link with P.Oxy. 48 3428.

Vote - AcceptText - Accept. Nice. I think this is pretty legible, and am not inclined to send out for review by Senior Eds (two Editorial Board members agreeing already); but if next voter disagrees, then (1) do not vote, (2) do add a 'Comment', and (3) send out for review. item.p: Ptoleminus son of Eulogios is also to be found in P.Michael. 33, 1-2, P.Harr. 2.219, 1, P.Oxy. 17.2110, 7 (N. Gonis, ZPE 150, 2004, 202). To this, one can now add P.Mich. 20.813, 6, P.Mich. 20.814, 4 and perhaps P.Mich. 20.820, 11 (P. Heilporn).
Flavius Barbatius is also to be found in P.Oxy. 48.3428, 10; his daughter Kuria appears in P.Michael. 33, 12 (N. Gonis, ZPE 150, 2004, 202).
